notions.titre: Expressing immediate future with « be going to »
notions.texte: Pour dire ce que tu vas faire bientôt, utilise be going to. C'est le futur proche.

Subject + BE (am / is / are) + going to + verb Subject + BE — Example I + am — I am going to visit my grandparents tomorrow. You + are — You are going to clean your bedroom this evening. He / She / It + is — She is going to cook rice tonight. We / You / They + are — We are going to watch TV in the living room. À l'oral, on raccourcit : I'm going to, she's going to, we're going to.
Word — En français tomorrow — demain tonight / this evening — ce soir this weekend — ce week-end next week — la semaine prochaine next Sunday — dimanche prochain
Oublier BE : I going to visit → I am going to visit. Changer le verbe : She is going to cooks → She is going to cook.
Going to marche comme « aller + verbe ». Je vais visiter → I am going to visit.
Cherche d'abord seule, à voix haute si tu peux. Ensuite, ouvre la correction.

Trouve le mot qui correspond. The son of your brother or of your sister. → … The daughter of your son or of your daughter. → … It's the room where we cook food. → … It's the room where we sleep. → … It's the room where we take a shower. → … A granddaughter

quiz.question: The son of your brother or of your sister is your…
quiz.explication: A nephew: the son of your brother or of your sister (un neveu).

quiz.question: The daughter of your son or of your daughter is your…
quiz.explication: A granddaughter: the daughter of your son or of your daughter (une petite-fille).

quiz.question: A child with no brother and no sister is…
quiz.explication: An only child = un enfant unique.

quiz.question: It's the room where we cook food.
quiz.explication: A kitchen: the room where we cook food (une cuisine).

quiz.question: It's the room where we sleep.
quiz.explication: A bedroom: the room where we sleep (une chambre).

quiz.question: « Be going to » sert à exprimer…
options: une action en train de se faire
quiz.explication: Be going to = le futur proche : ce que tu vas faire bientôt.

quiz.question: Complete: I ___ visit my grandparents tomorrow.
quiz.explication: I + am + going to + verb: I am going to visit.

quiz.question: Complete: She ___ cook rice tonight.
quiz.explication: She + is + going to + verb: She is going to cook.

quiz.question: Quelle phrase est CORRECTE ?
options: We are going to watches TV.
We are going to watch TV.
quiz.reponse: We are going to watch TV.
quiz.explication: BE + going to + verbe sans changement : We are going to watch TV.

quiz.question: Quelle est la forme négative de « They are going to play. » ?
options: They are going not to play.
quiz.explication: On ajoute not après BE : They are not (aren't) going to play.

quiz.question: Choose the correct question.
quiz.explication: BE goes before the subject: Are you going to cook?

quiz.question: Which word shows the future?
quiz.explication: Tomorrow (demain), tonight, next week, this weekend: les mots du futur.
